rules.game: Optional filter; no game defines the storage structure.
rules.values: Preserve source values and units; any JSON value is permitted. No universal numeric score is assumed.
rules.identity: Source-scoped native identity. Cross-device player identity requires evidence; names alone do not establish it.
rules.relations: Addressed links; shared events appear once and player ledgers reference them.
rules.time: Retain timestamp, timezone, precision and ordering scope. Unknown values remain null.
rules.history: Append observations and corrections with references to the records they amend; do not overwrite the retained source.
rules.extensions: Game rules, nesting, outcomes, teams and score dimensions are carried as source payload or addressed relations, without a fixed match/leg hierarchy.
rules.void: Existing source addresses retained. Void-specific codec remains unresolved.
